scope: scoped review: requirement trace, deterministic checks, public surface, test design. GeneratedFormatterCollector.cs (300 lines) and the four new analyzer rules were not reviewed line by line.

requirement_verdicts.confidence_basis: The feature is new and absent on base (the runtime tests don't compile with the source reverted; tests.execution_fail_without_fix pass). Under SDK 9 the 7 execution tests pass: a consuming assembly declares [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] partial formatters for types in a test assembly that deliberately doesn't reference MessagePack (the issue's Project A scenario), and they round-trip and register in the generated resolver. This covers the clause as written. It does not cover everything the issue discusses (Union and other attribute-driven settings for external types), which I refuse below.

evidence.quote: This assembly deliberately does NOT reference MessagePack.

findings.title: New public API in MessagePack.Annotations is not tracked by any PublicAPI file
findings.claim: The change adds a public GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute (with a public SurrogateType property) to a shipping assembly, plus public analyzer descriptors MsgPack019-022. MessagePack.Annotations has no PublicAPI.*.txt, so the PublicApiAnalyzers gate never saw it (public_api check = fail). Once shipped, this API is permanent, so a maintainer has to approve its name and shape explicitly.
findings.suggested_fix: Get maintainer sign-off on the API shape; consider adding PublicAPI tracking to MessagePack.Annotations.

findings.title: New test-support project is not in MessagePack.sln
findings.claim: tests/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.ExternalTypes is only reachable through a ProjectReference from ExecutionTests. It is missing from the solution (solution_membership = fail), so IDE and solution-level builds don't show or build it directly.

findings.title: New StyleCop warning SA1203 in the new test file
findings.claim: GeneratedMessagePackFormatterTests declares a const field after an instance field, adding 1 build warning vs base (analyzers = fail).

findings.title: External-type execution tests are excluded from the MapMode execution suite
findings.claim: MapModeExecutionTests now excludes GeneratedFormatterForExternalTypes*.cs, so the new feature is never tested with map mode (tests.targeted.execution reports no matching tests there).

refusals.topic: Correctness of GeneratedFormatterCollector.cs and the MessagePackGenerator.cs pipeline changes beyond what the 7 execution and 6 generator tests exercise (generic formatters, nested/abstract types, interaction with existing [MessagePackObject] collection, incremental-generator caching)
refusals.reason: Scoped review: I did not read these 300+ lines line by line. Tests show only the happy paths and the 4 diagnostics.

refusals.topic: Whether the API design (SurrogateType, contractless default for external types) is the right answer to the issue, which also asks for Union and other attribute-driven settings
refusals.reason: Product/API design decision with permanent public surface; the issue proposes three alternatives and the change picks a fourth (surrogate type).

refusals.topic: Security/trust implications of generating formatters that access members of external types (e.g. non-public members)
refusals.reason: Not examined in this scoped review.
